article.title: The 3,000 Miles Home Journal
article.description: Arjun Nair's ₹2.6 Cr remote home-buying journey from Dubai to Whitefield & Hennur — trusting WhatsApp video calls, a 12-point visit protocol, and his brother's gut.
article.quote: "I'm trusting a WhatsApp video and my brother's gut."

learnings.text: 12-point video call protocol beats unguided site visits
Verify NRE repatriation & consulate POA before paying booking fees

chatMessages.text: Riya, I'm 3,000 kilometers away. Every broker says 'sir 100% verified'. How do I know if the POA is legit before transferring ₹2.5 crore?
Arjun, remote confidence requires process over promises. We check consulate attestation, Section 195 TDS challans, and single-owner Drive folders first. Trips verify; process decides.

beforeItems.text: WhatsApp videos from brokers are sufficient diligence
A 6-day vacation trip will solve all property decisions
Any POA document gives full right to execute sale
Delaying purchase costs nothing while staying in Dubai

afterItems.text: 12-point structured video protocol executed by trusted proxy
Trips verify details; established process makes decisions
Consulate-attested POA with explicit sale clause required
Repricing cost of waiting escalated 3BHK by ₹60L in 3 years

differentlyCards.title: Standardize video visits early
differentlyCards.description: Using a 12-point video checklist from Month 1 would have saved 3 months of unorganized phone calls.

differentlyCards.title: Verify POA scope on Day 1
differentlyCards.description: Checking for explicit 'sale' authorization before paying lawyer fees avoids wasted legal costs.

differentlyCards.title: Stick strictly to brand developers
differentlyCards.description: Direct primary brand purchases eliminate title chain complexity for overseas buyers.

differentlyCards.title: Engage property management early
differentlyCards.description: Pre-booking tenant management ensures immediate rental income upon possession.

chatMessages.text: Trusting a WhatsApp video and my brother's gut worked because we built a 12-point process around it. Process decides.
Exactly, Arjun. Distance doesn't weaken diligence when your protocol is airtight.

tabs.adviceStoryboardImagePrompt: A vector storyboard showing Dubai video calling, brother site visiting, consulate POA signing, and key handover, rendered in an 80% greyscale monochrome palette (#1E1E1E to #FFFFFF) with a Warm Coral #FF8A65 focal accent, Scandinavian minimalism, clean white background.
tabs.adviceDescription: For NRI investors 3,000 miles away, confidence comes from structured video protocols, consulate-attested POA verification, and choosing brand developers with proven delivery records. Arjun proved that remote home buying succeeds when process leads and trips merely verify.

monthlyLearnings.headline: The Power of Attorney (POA) is the project
monthlyLearnings.body: Drafting, notarizing, and consular apostilling the POA takes longer than shortlisting — start it first.

monthlyLearnings.headline: Quarterly RERA portal progress tracking reveals real speed
monthlyLearnings.body: Comparing RERA filings across 4 quarters revealed which developer actually pours concrete on schedule.

monthlyLearnings.headline: Video-visit protocol resolves spreadsheet vs gut feel conflicts
monthlyLearnings.body: When spreadsheet and brother's gut feel disagreed, asking "Which of us has stood in the flat?" resolved it.

monthlyLearnings.headline: NRI Section 195 TDS mechanics require primary developer flow
monthlyLearnings.body: Buyer-side tax compliance rules for NRIs differ significantly from resale individual seller rules.

monthlyLearnings.headline: Optimized for verifiability over perfect specs from 3,000 km
monthlyLearnings.body: From abroad, documentation verifiability and brand developer track record are the true metrics of value.

checklistItems: You are buying in Bengaluru from another country, and every decision passes through one trusted relative.
You will pay a known premium for a brand developer because dispute resolution from abroad is impossible.
You read RERA filings at midnight in your timezone, and you trust documents over site visits you can't make.
The flat is simultaneously an investment, a return-option, and proof the years abroad added up — and you haven't ranked the three.
A family deadline (school, parents) gives your decision a real expiry date.
You've watched the market reprice between your visits home, and waiting again frightens you more than committing.
